column27: Belarus's largest quant-adjacent employer segment: EPAM Systems, Andersen, Innowise, Itransition — analytics and data science teams occasionally work on financial risk models, pricing algorithms, or algorithmic strategies for international clients. Closest to quant finance in Belarus context. No junior quant market — effectively starts at middle level. Figures approximate NET at HTP companies (9% tax)

Priorbank (Raiffeisen Belarus), BPS-Sberbank, Alfa-Bank Belarus, Belarusbank — risk analytics departments model credit risk, IFRS9, Basel-adjacent metrics. Very small teams. Pay significantly below Western Europe; below HTP outsourcing too due to non-IT sector wage structure. Approximate NET

Wargaming (World of Tanks) Minsk employs game economy analysts and data scientists who use quantitative methods for in-game economy modelling. Not quant finance but the most sophisticated quantitative work available in Belarus outside IT outsourcing. Figures estimated from Wargaming talent market reports. HTP tax regime applies. Very limited data
